descriptions.sole_trader: Best for one-person businesses and freelancers with personal tax obligations.
descriptions.partnership: For shared ownership businesses where partners split profits and reporting duties.
descriptions.limited_company: For registered companies that need company tax guidance and annual filing support.

tinVerify.title: Verify Your TIN
tinVerify.body: Your TIN is required on all invoices. Without it, 10% WHT applies to ALL payments you receive.
tinVerify.nrsNote: Managed by NRS (Nigeria Revenue Service, formerly FIRS)
tinVerify.pendingNote: Verification takes 1–2 minutes via NRS. We'll notify you automatically.
tinVerify.educationBody: A valid TIN reduces payment friction, protects you from avoidable withholding, and makes invoices easier for clients to approve.

vatSetup.title: VAT Setup
vatSetup.exemptTitle: Good news — you may be exempt from filing VAT returns
vatSetup.exemptBody: Businesses under ₦100M turnover are exempt from filing VAT returns. However you MUST still charge 7.5% VAT on all invoices.
vatSetup.requiredBody: Your business must file VAT returns by the 21st of each month.
vatSetup.educationBody: Even if you are exempt from filing, you still need to charge 7.5% VAT on goods and services. TaxBridge will track this automatically in every invoice you create.

einvoice.title: E-Invoicing
einvoice.phaseSmall: Mandatory from July 2027 for your business size. Set up now — banks offer faster invoice financing to e-invoice-ready businesses.
einvoice.phaseMedium: Pilot phase active. Mandatory July 1 2026. Apply for FIRSMBS integration now.
einvoice.phaseLarge: ⚠️ E-INVOICING ENFORCEMENT IS ACTIVE. Non-compliance = ₦200,000 penalty + 100% of tax due.
einvoice.educationBody: Businesses that adopt e-invoicing early get faster loan approvals, smoother audits, and better trust scores with larger clients and banks.

community.shareBody: Show clients and partners your verified compliance status. A strong badge signals trustworthiness.
community.benefitBody: Get early access to new features, tax law change alerts, and connect with other business owners navigating the same compliance journey.
